zh.title: 关于转型的思考
zh.intro: 为什么决定不接着干码农了呢？ In short：时代变化的推动 + 个人性格的回归。
paragraphs: 一方面，近年来飞速发展的 AI coding 能力使得纯粹的代码技术变得越来越廉价。Claude Opus 4.5 的重磅发布以及 MCP/Skills 等技术的出现，证实了 Coding Agent 已经可以从需求理解、架构分析、代码编写、测试用例生成、构建调试、自主修复、上线监控等流程上实现闭环。我坚信旧事物的崩塌必然伴随着新事物的诞生，转型阵痛的同时也一定伴随着新的机遇。
另一方面，我打小就嘴贫话多坐不住，梦想有一天可以滔滔不绝地给各种人讲。PDSA 这种岗位又能说话，又能看技术，又能看项目，又能天南海北到处跑，真是不错诶，大喜，遂冲！
zh.quote: 未来最重要的能力是 Vision 和 Taste。在模糊的环境下，总能做出那个"对"的选择——在不确定性中勇往直前！

en.title: On Career Transition
en.intro: Why did I stop being a full-time software engineer? In short: the push of a changing era + a return to my natural personality.
paragraphs: On one hand, the rapid development of AI coding capabilities has made pure coding skills increasingly commoditized. The release of Claude Opus 4.5 and technologies like MCP/Skills have proven that Coding Agents can already achieve end-to-end automation across requirement analysis, architecture design, code generation, testing, debugging, and deployment. I firmly believe that the collapse of old paradigms inevitably brings the birth of new ones — with pain comes new opportunity.

On the other hand, I've always been talkative and restless since childhood, dreaming of a day when I could speak passionately to all kinds of people. The PDSA role lets me talk, explore technology, manage projects, and travel — the perfect fit!
en.quote: The most important abilities for the future are Vision and Taste. Being able to consistently make the "right" choice in ambiguous environments — charging forward through uncertainty!
